remarks: Welcome to your dream condo in a beautifully converted Victorian mansion! This immaculate one-level, 2-bedroom apartment boasts elegant hardwood floors, soaring 12-foot ceilings, and a charming stone fireplace. The spacious living area opens onto a fabulous private deck, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Enjoy modern comforts with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a convenient in-unit washer and dryer. With 1 full bathroom, 2 entrances (including direct access from the front porch), and 2 assigned parking spaces, this home has both style and convenience. The building features a brand new roof as of August 2024. Located just 33 miles from NYC and only 1.4 miles (7 minutes) from the Amtrak and Metro North train station, this condo is ideal for both city commuters and those seeking a serene retreat.
